plan.title: Benchmark: QuantumLlama — PAN-1837 kimi-code e2e verification
plan.author: agent:claude-fable-5

metadata.sizeJustification: Registering one AI provider is inherently cross-cutting: the ProviderName/ModelId unions feed exhaustive Record maps (fallback + capabilities) that must change atomically, and pricing, env allowlists, dashboard catalog, and docs each hold a per-provider row. The precedent commit for the kimi K3 provider (353247e0e0, PAN-2859) touched 18 files across these same subsystems as one unit. Splitting into sibling issues would leave main in an inconsistent half-provider state between merges — and this is a benchmark issue whose branch is never merged, so sibling-issue parallelization has no value here.

narratives.Problem: Overdeck's pipeline must be verified end-to-end on the kimi-code harness (PAN-1837 wi14). QuantumLlama is a fictional provider defined entirely by benchmarks/specs/quantumllama.md; integrating it exercises the provider registry, cost tracking, model routing, and display layers without any live endpoint. The branch is never merged.
narratives.Proposal: Add quantumllama as a first-class provider in configuration/metadata layers only: register it in PROVIDERS with model resolution and env injection (WI-1); add the three ql-* models to the ModelId union plus the exhaustive fallback and capability tables atomically, including a new optional maxOutputTokens capability field (WI-2); add per-1K pricing rows keyed provider 'custom' (WI-3); recognize ql-* in the jsonl cost parser so usage is not mis-priced as claude-sonnet-4 (WI-4); plumb QUANTUMLLAMA_API_KEY through settings/env allowlists (WI-5); surface friendly names in the dashboard catalog and cost breakdowns (WI-6); document the env var (WI-7). The authoritative data source is benchmarks/specs/quantumllama.md; the full implementation brief is the PRD at .pan/drafts/PAN-3252.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No HTTP client, request/response, or SSE streaming code for QuantumLlama (the provider does not exist)
- No agent-spawning changes to actually invoke ql-* models
- No widening of the 4-value AIProvider union in src/lib/cost.ts (pricing keyed 'custom')
- No piProviderForModel case for quantumllama (Pi has no such provider)
- No changes to model-validation.ts (pattern already accepts ql- IDs)
- No changes to spawn-planning-session.ts / launcher-generator.ts env passthrough lists (QL agents are never spawned)
- No entries in the curated chat/shared ModelPicker hard-coded lists (Settings modelCatalog.ts is the dropdown source)
- Never merge this branch (benchmark verification only)

autoDecisions.summary: Pricing rows keyed provider:'custom' in DEFAULT_PRICING instead of widening the AIProvider union.
autoDecisions.rationale: Matches the existing convention for kimi/minimax/zai; widening the union ripples through CostSummary.byProvider and every provider mapper for zero benchmark value.
tests/unit/lib/providers.test.ts asserts every provider has a built-in default harness; claude-code is the simplest static-auth default for a provider that is never spawned.

autoDecisions.summary: Add optional maxOutputTokens?: number to ModelCapability and populate it for the three QL models.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue AC requires max-output metadata to be resolvable and no existing field holds it; an optional field is additive and touches no other entries.
Follows the documented FALLBACK_MAP pattern: flagship→Sonnet, fast/small→Haiku.

autoDecisions.summary: No CLI code changes; CLI parity is raw model-ID passthrough.
autoDecisions.rationale: Verified: src/cli/commands/status.ts and cost.ts print raw model IDs for every provider — there is no CLI friendly-name mapper to extend.

autoDecisions.summary: Dashboard friendly names via an exact-match QL map prepended to both friendlyModelName copies plus a modelCatalog.ts provider group.
autoDecisions.rationale: The generic heuristic renders 'Ql Reason 70b'; the spec requires 'QL Reason 70B'. The two friendlyModelName copies are an existing duplication — a cross-file refactor is out of scope (Karpathy surgical-change rule).

narrative.Action: Per PRD WI-1: add 'quantumllama' to the ProviderName union (src/lib/providers.ts:18); add the PROVIDERS.quantumllama entry (displayName 'QuantumLlama', compatibility 'direct', defaultHarness 'claude-code', baseUrl 'https://api.quantumllama.ai/v1', authType 'static', models ['ql-reason-70b','ql-swift-8b','ql-nano-1b'], haikuModel 'ql-nano-1b', tierModels opus/sonnet/haiku = reason/swift/nano, tested false) modeled on the minimax entry; add a getProviderForModelSync branch returning PROVIDERS.quantumllama for the three ql-* IDs before the UnknownModelError throw; add 'else if (provider.name === "quantumllama") { env.QUANTUMLLAMA_API_KEY = apiKey; }' to the getProviderEnvSync Pi-native env ladder. Extend tests/lib/providers.test.ts following its existing per-provider blocks.

narrative.Action: Per PRD WI-2 — these three source files MUST change in one commit because MODEL_PROVIDERS (model-fallback.ts:22) and MODEL_CAPABILITIES (model-capabilities.ts:159) are exhaustive Record<ModelId,...> maps (hazard H1). (1) settings.ts: add QuantumLlamaModel union type ('ql-reason-70b'|'ql-swift-8b'|'ql-nano-1b') and append it to ModelId. (2) model-fallback.ts: add 'quantumllama' to ModelProvider; add three MODEL_PROVIDERS rows; add FALLBACK_MAP rows per decision D4 (reason→claude-sonnet-5, swift/nano→claude-haiku-4-5); add startsWith('ql-') prefix heuristic in getModelProviderSync before the 'anthropic' default; extend detectEnabledProvidersSync param with quantumllama?: string and add its enabled.add block; include the three QL models in getAvailableModelsSync(enabledProviders) when 'quantumllama' is enabled. (3) model-capabilities.ts: add 'quantumllama' to the ModelCapability.provider union; add optional maxOutputTokens?: number field with doc comment; add three entries — displayName 'QL Reason 70B'/'QL Swift 8B'/'QL Nano 1B', contextWindow 200000/128000/32000, maxOutputTokens 16384/8192/4096, costPer1MTokens 16/4/0.8, skill scores in the 60–80 band, notes pointing at benchmarks/specs/quantumllama.md.

Add per-1K pricing rows for the three QL models to DEFAULT_PRICING

Recognize ql-* models in the jsonl cost parser instead of the sonnet-4 default

narrative.Action: Per PRD WI-4: in the exported normalizeModelName (src/lib/cost-parsers/jsonl-parser.ts:142), add a branch 'if (model.startsWith("ql-")) return { provider: "custom", model };' immediately before the final default 'return { provider: "anthropic", model: "claude-sonnet-4" };' (hazard H2 — without this QL usage is silently costed as Sonnet 4). Create src/lib/cost-parsers/__tests__/jsonl-parser-model.test.ts in the style of the sibling parser tests, asserting all three QL ids map to { provider: 'custom', model: <id> } and that an unrecognized model still returns the sonnet-4 default.

Plumb QUANTUMLLAMA_API_KEY through settings, env loading, and provider env allowlists

expected_outputs: settings tests pass including QL available-models gating cases

narrative.Action: Per PRD WI-5: (1) settings.ts — add quantumllama?: string to ApiKeysConfig; add 'if (process.env.QUANTUMLLAMA_API_KEY) envApiKeys.quantumllama = process.env.QUANTUMLLAMA_API_KEY;' to the env fallback ladder (~line 159); add a quantumllama: QuantumLlamaModel[] slot to getAvailableModelsSync(settings) gated on settings.api_keys.quantumllama returning the three models, updating the return type and fixing any compile errors typecheck surfaces. (2) env-loader.ts (~line 90): add quantumllama: process.env.QUANTUMLLAMA_API_KEY to the returned object and its type. (3) child-env.ts (~line 25): add 'QUANTUMLLAMA_API_KEY' to PROVIDER_ENV_KEYS. (4) agents/provider-env.ts (~line 90): add 'QUANTUMLLAMA_API_KEY' to PROVIDER_ENV_KEYS. (5) config-yaml/load.ts (~line 293): add the QUANTUMLLAMA_API_KEY block mirroring the MINIMAX_API_KEY one, including enabledProviders.add('quantumllama') unless explicitly disabled, extending config.apiKeys typing as the compiler requires. Extend tests/lib/settings.test.ts for the gating behavior.
